label: Visual
tagline: Images, icons, illustrations, decorative ambient motion
description: Classifies every visual slot (img, background-image, canvas, declared shader/lottie/3d paths) by medium and dispatches one per-medium drawer per slot. Modes: HTML-enumeration (post source-write) and Bare Intent (chat-triggered ad-hoc image requests). Step 8 QA checks style coherence + composition + cutout + text contrast after assets land.

triggers.title: Bare Intent — chat
triggers.rule: When the user's message mentions ANY visual content (image, illustration, mascot, character, icon, logo, shader, particle, 3D, lottie, video) — FIRST action is a Task call to visual-planner.

triggers.title: Stage I — bp_proto_build Phase 2a
triggers.rule: After source HTML is written by bp_proto_build Phase 1, Phase 2a dispatches visual-planner against the source tree for HTML-enumeration.
